Name: Ran's Farm Decor
Author: ranfuu
Description:
[b]FEATURES:[/b][list]
[*]Giant crop huts (and an igloo) for your junimos
[*]A new friend to watch over your fields
[*]Plant markers for your gardens
[*]New food bowls and cushion for your pet
[*]Make grandpa’s shrine look nicer and give yourself reason to visit him often
[/list]
[b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b]
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
[b]
INSTALL:[/b]
- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Place in your “\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder
- Run game with SMAPI

[b]UNINSTALL:[/b]
- Simply remove from folder
[b]
CONFIG:[/b]
- Turn any of the mods on/off - “enabled”, “disabled”
- Winter palette variation for hut and scarecrow - “vanilla”, “desaturated”
- Switch between default and seasonal pet area - “true”, “false”

[b]CREDIT:[/b]
[url=http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/]http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/
[/url][b]
Personal edits ok
Please do not reupload/redistribute[/b]
